summary: Greenbriar Sustainable Living Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act) attaching a news release announcing the appointment of Dominique Ramuz as Managing Director of its Renewable Energy Advisory Board. The appointment is a routine board-level governance change; no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or other special situation is involved. The registrant is the issuer of the filing. No deal terms or price/share are applicable.
